pages.text: A glimmer given lasting form. It survives away from its nucleus, can be stored and transported, and replaces fleeting fragments in basic recipes. Its tooltip records the actual stored amount.

pages.title: Let it flow again
pages.text: Use it on a finite reservoir with room to release its stored aether. Processing aether was already spent and cannot return.$(br2)Crystalline material also makes a personal anchor, giving aether a path to follow you beyond the amethyst branches.
